eightfold_ask: New CHRO / CPO / Head of TA / Head of Talent Intelligence at an ICP account (discovery call)
population: Company audience segment: cohort parents + in-scope divisions
fires_when: A tracked company hires someone matching job_title_keywords and seniority
false_positive_warning: Search-style title matching returns assistants, analysts and offshore TA leads. Apply the leaders.py gate before anything is routed.
evidence_from_this_build: Live people search returned 68 people; the gate kept 13 at 9 accounts (talent_leaders.csv).

eightfold_ask: Same, at companies NOT in Salesforce (white space)
clay_signal_type: NewHire on a white-space segment, fed by the weekly ingest
population: Segment built by the white-space workflow after exclusion + ICP gate
fires_when: As above, on the white-space population
false_positive_warning: Domain-only exclusion hides a new division that shares a customer's domain (optum.com vs unitedhealthgroup.com are separate; HCA Physician Services shares hcahealthcare.com).
evidence_from_this_build: divisions.csv: 12 of 30 parents have more than one in-scope hiring entity.

eightfold_ask: Recruiting / HR-tech hiring at an account (requisition volume as demand driver)
fires_when: A tracked company opens a posting matching filters (seniority, employment_type, keywords)
false_positive_warning: Aggregate posting counts are not a signal; filter to recruiting, HR technology and talent roles. Fetch seniority / employment_type values from create --help; a misspelling matches nothing.
evidence_from_this_build: Open Jobs enrichment dispatched on 11 accounts; read-back failed, so no requisition counts are in this repo.

eightfold_ask: Champion or buying-committee member leaves (churn risk) or lands at a new account
fires_when: A tracked person's current employer changes
false_positive_warning: Ships with default filter confidence >= 90. A missing or stale LinkedIn URL is silently not monitored.
evidence_from_this_build: One qualified TA leader's existing Audiences record carries an email at a previous employer - the decay this watch exists to catch.

eightfold_ask: Title advancement inside the buying committee
fires_when: Title advances at the same company
false_positive_warning: Same default confidence filter as JobChange.

fires_when: A tracked company appears in news matching topics (funding is a News topic)
false_positive_warning: Reductions and expansions are both signals in opposite directions; do not auto-disqualify on a layoff (confirm with Eightfold's demand gen lead).
evidence_from_this_build: Honeywell (separation, new CHRO Jul 2026 + Chief Talent Officer Apr 2026), GE (three successor companies), Marsh (renamed, -3% headcount over 3 months) all surfaced as identity events in this build.

eightfold_ask: Account-level intent - and whether it duplicates 6sense
fires_when: A tracked company researches configured topics
false_positive_warning: topicIds come from search-topics per provider; never guess or copy. Provider set is fixed at creation. A provider config without topicIds watches (and bills) every topic.
evidence_from_this_build: Not run. This is where the 6sense overlap question gets answered.

eightfold_ask: 'Anything relevant', not a named query (discovery call)
fires_when: An enrichment you configure returns a change
false_positive_warning: Cannot be created or updated from the CLI. Say so rather than promising it.
